scope: One sampler, one model, one PostgreSQL database per sequential deployment. 6D f(x)=x[0], zero evaluator delay. Materialized with 16 active evaluators; training with 64. 64 evaluators registered for both.
validity: Production frontier warmup and accepted progress windows. Training requires feedback; counts and failures retained. Queue timings deduplicate telemetry snapshots and exclude the initial endpoint. CPU use is process CPU seconds divided by CLI measurement wall time. Backend waits are diagnostic samples, not a wall-time attribution.

failed_trials.error: Completed-batch cleanup and subsequent run-removal DELETE each exceeded PostgreSQL statement_timeout (30s). Private deployment shutdown was clean.
